Messages.Author: Rob LeGood
Messages.Body:
The rules state that the last stolen blood burns the vampire. Can you
play a card to steal blood off of a vampire who currently has no blood,
and if so, does the vampire get burnt? If not, what happens?

rob.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


Stealing a vampire's last blood won't burn the vampire in the full
(advanced) game. It only burns him in the basic game.

In the basic game, stealing X blood from an empty vampire will
burn him, since you have stolen "all of the vampire's blood".

--

It is in the errata to the rulebook, published in the Duelist and
posted by Tom Wylie to the newsgroup:

Section 21, Advanced combat/check damage
In the advanced game, if a vampire steals more blood from a vampire
than it has blood to give, do not burn the second vampire. Simply transfer
all of its blood to the first vampire.

The text version of the rulebook, with errata at the end, is available
from my Web page:

http://Rulemonger.Home.ML.Org

This has been errataed. In Jyhad stealing all a Vamp's blood
didn't burn them, but by creating V:TES basic rules they forgot to
reinsert the old rule. In Darkness Unveiled when they go over the V:TES
rules line by line they add "Stealing blood: In the Advanced Game, if a

vampire steals more blood from a vampire than it has blood to give, do

not burn the second vampire. Transfer all the second vampire's blood to
the first vampire (and ignore excess blood)."-Darkness Unveiled pg45
V:TES rules version 3.2 inserted into advanced game rules-choose strike
between hand damage modifiers & long range combat.
